invariants.description: Uncertain or unobserved state must never be reported as compliant or successful.
When a model, hardware device, or dependency is offline, confidence must be null—never 0.
Inference failures must never be swallowed by .catch(() => []) to fake an empty detection list.
Intentional simulations must carry provenance: 'SIMULATION' and simulated: true. Mock providers are strictly rejected in production.
Rule-based heuristic scores must be labeled as heuristicScore with provenance: 'HEURISTIC_RULE_ENGINE'.

auditedItems.previousBehavior: Hardcoded confidence = 0.85 when head detected without classifier; confidence = 0 when uncertain.
auditedItems.remediation: Uses true observed head confidence for violations; returns confidence: null when uncertain; attaches AIExecutionMetadata.

auditedItems.previousBehavior: Returned confidence: 0 for MODEL_UNAVAILABLE; fallback person.confidence || 0.85; swallowed inference errors.
auditedItems.remediation: Returns confidence: null for MODEL_UNAVAILABLE; reclassified density score as heuristicScore; fails closed on pipeline error.
